change.title: ⚠️ Images: Remove OpenTelemetry
change.detail: ⚠️ Images: Remove OpenTelemetry. (#12024) ⚠️ OpenTelemetry is still supported, but since the module is built into the controller image since v1.10, we hereby remove the init container and image which were used to install it upon controller startup.
